Create a single game sprite sheet image for an isometric 2D game: the WILDLIFE of a VOLCANIC
PLANET (Venus-like: basalt, ash, sulphur and rivers of magma). Twelve creatures - BIG,
AGGRESSIVE and VERY ALIEN: nothing like Earth animals - asymmetric bodies, too many limbs or
none, armour of cooled basalt plates, molten magma glowing through cracks in their hides,
obsidian spines and blades, sulphur-yellow gas sacs, heat shimmer vents, clusters of glowing
eyes, jaws that open in four directions, tendrils of living lava. Predators built to burn and
crush. Style: 1980s anime creature design (think 80s anime films and OVA monsters) -
cel-painted, clean bold dark outlines, flat colour areas with 2-3 tone cel shading, crisp
highlights, saturated palette (basalt black-purple, rust red, ash grey, sulphur yellow, and
magma glowing deep red to orange to yellow-white), dramatic and menacing.

LAYOUT REFERENCE: attach ice_creatures.png (or forest_creatures.png) and copy its layout
exactly - the same canvas, grid, poses and facing; only the creatures change.

=== CANVAS (exact) ===
- Image size: exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
- Background: one flat solid colour, pure magenta #FF00FF, everywhere that is not a creature.
  No gradient, no texture, no vignette, no grid lines, no borders, no labels, no text.
- Grid: 8 columns x 6 rows of invisible cells, each 192 x 170 pixels. Exactly ONE figure per
  cell, centred in it, never crossing its cell; at least 6 px of magenta around each figure.
  Only a small soft dark contact shadow under each figure (no glow halos onto the background).

=== VIEW AND POSES ===
- Isometric game view (camera about 30 degrees above), every creature FACING DOWN-LEFT
  (toward the viewer's lower-left), the same scale for all twelve, feet on the bottom third
  of the cell.
- Each row holds TWO creatures, each in 4 poses left to right:
  stand (idle, menacing), move A, move B (two frames of its walk / crawl / flight cycle -
  the legs or body clearly different between them), act (its attack: biting, spitting magma,
  slashing, slamming, charging - the most aggressive moment).
  Columns 0-3: the first creature's stand, move A, move B, act; columns 4-7: the second's.
- They are BIG: the largest fill most of a cell (up to 170 px tall / 180 px long); even the
  smallest are as big as a person (no tiny critters).

=== THE CREATURES (row by row: first creature, second creature) ===
Row 0: 1 MAGMA BEHEMOTH - a hulking six-legged brute with a back of basalt slabs, magma
  pouring from the seams, a lower jaw that splits sideways (act: rears and slams, magma
  spraying); 2 CINDER STALKER - a lean, long-limbed predator on four bladed legs, an eyeless
  head ringed with glowing pits, a whip tail of embers (act: lunges with jaws wide open).
Row 1: 3 OBSIDIAN MANTIS - a towering insectoid with glassy black scythe arms and a crest of
  obsidian shards (act: double scythe strike); 4 SULPHUR BLOATER - a floating sac of yellow
  gas held up by thin legs, a cluster of eyes underneath, a beak that vents gas (act: spits
  a burst of burning yellow gas).
Row 2: 5 LAVA SERPENT - a huge armoured worm rising out of the ground, its body segments
  glowing between basalt rings, a four-way opening mouth (act: rears and spits a stream of
  magma); 6 VENT CRAB - a tank-like crab with a smoking chimney growing from its shell and
  oversized basalt claws (act: claw crush, the chimney erupting).
Row 3: 7 PYROCLAST HOUND - a pack hunter with a skull like a cracked lava rock, burning mane,
  six legs, too many teeth (act: leaping bite); 8 ASH WRAITH - a tall thin floating thing of
  ash and smoke around a glowing molten core, long clawed arms trailing embers (act: lashes
  out with both claws, the core flaring).
Row 4: 9 BASALT GOLEM - a colossus of hexagonal basalt columns walking on four column legs,
  magma eyes in its chest (act: swings a column arm down); 10 EMBER SWARM QUEEN - a winged
  alien with membranous wings of glowing veins and a stinger tail, hovering (act: dives,
  stinger first, sparks streaming).
Row 5: 11 CRATER MAW - a creature that is mostly mouth: a ring of obsidian teeth on a squat
  armoured body with short legs, a magma tongue (act: mouth gaping, tongue lashing out);
  12 FUMAROLE TITAN - a giant hunched beast with vents along its spine pouring smoke, heavy
  forearms and a horned head plate (act: roars, vents erupting, forearms raised).

=== RULES ===
- The same creature looks exactly the same in its 4 poses (colours, markings, proportions).
- Every creature reads clearly as dangerous and alien at small size: bold silhouettes.
- Do not use magenta (#FF00FF) or near-magenta / pink colours anywhere in the artwork
  (smoke and gas are grey, black or sulphur yellow, never pink).
- No people, no text, no labels, no watermark anywhere on the image.
